Weslock 0605B, Traditional Ambassador Lever with Round Rose

The Ambassador Leverset is available in satin nickel and oil rubbed bronze finishes. Made by Weslock, the Ambassador Lever with Round Rose is available in dummy, privacy, passage, and keyed functions. The keyed and privacy functions offer emergency egress, which means that turning the interior lever immediately releases the lock. The Ambassador Lever has a certain elegance that gives off an air of richness. It is adjustable to fit door thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches. The backset is also adjustable for either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches with a removable faceplate

This classic lever is from the Weslock Traditionale Collection which features solid brass construction as well as lifetime mechanical and finish warranties.

Features of the Weslock Traditionale Collection Ambassador Leverset with Round Rosette:

  • The keyed entry function features a 5-pin cylinder and meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • Fully ADA Compliant
  • Panic-proof keyed entry and privacy functions means that one turn of interior lever unlocks and opens door.
  • Locksets have pre-installed installation screws, which are concealed behind a snap-on rosette.
  • Removable lever prevents scratching during installation.
  • All brass lever and rosette.
  • Limited lifetime mechanical warranty.
  • Limited 10 year finish warranty.
  • Lifetime PVD finish on exterior polished brass.

Specifications of the Traditionale Collection Ambassador Lever:

  • Lever Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-1/4"
  • Latch Diameter: 7/8"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplate.
  • Door Thickness: adjustable from 1-3/8" to 1-3/4".

When Selecting a Function:

  • Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim. Does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock. Door lever operates latch from either side of door.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking for privacy. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy lock; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy and retract latchbolt.
  • Keyed Entry (keyed lock): Use when a keyed lock is needed. Locked and unlocked by a key from the outside and push button on interior rose. Turning inside lever will release lock and retract latchbolt.
